title: HF3954 (2017-2018 Regular): Transfer of semiautomatic military-style assault weapons prohibited, semiautomatic military-style assault weapon buyback program established, criminal penalties provided, and money appropriated.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/90/2018/0/HF/3954/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version (as filed, no date given on the page). Section 1 strikes the old list of named weapon models and the sporting-purposes exclusion and writes a features-based definition. Section 2 lists exceptions (law enforcement, family transfers, estates, antiques, curios, temporary transfers) that are not quoted here.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.712, subd. 7): (1) semiautomatic rifle that has the capacity to accept a detachable magazine and has at least two of the following:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.712, subd. 7): (4) conversion kit, part, or combination of parts from which a semiautomatic military-style assault weapon can be assembled if those parts are in the possession or under the control of the same person.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 624.7134, subd. 1): It is unlawful to transfer a semiautomatic military-style assault weapon.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 624.7134, subd. 3): A person who violates subdivision 1 is guilty of a gross misdemeanor.
Section 3 (uncodified): The commissioner of public safety shall create a voluntary semiautomatic military-style assault weapon buyback program.
Section 3 (uncodified): Nothing in this section compels the owner of a semiautomatic military-style assault weapon to sell the owner's semiautomatic military-style assault weapon to law enforcement or a firearms dealer.
Section 4 (uncodified): $500,000 in fiscal year 2019 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for the implementation of the voluntary semiautomatic military-style assault weapon buyback program under section 3.
